tips.text: Pledge Suda before Steel Meridian; the two never hurt each other, so you lose nothing.
Max Suda and Hexis first, then pledge Steel Meridian to raise Red Veil without costing either.
Run Suda's daily Syndicate Alerts and grab the medallions; they pay out past the daily standing cap.
Bring Thief's Wit, Loot Detector or Animal Instinct so medallions show on the minimap.
Rank up the moment the bar fills; Red Veil and New Loka keep draining while it sits full.
Build up Red Veil before you pledge Suda so the drain does not drop you to a hostile rank.
Pledge Suda directly instead of Hexis; Hexis costs Red Veil the full amount.
Expect to pay each rank-up sacrifice only once, even if you fall back and climb again.
Farm affinity in Elite Sanctuary Onslaught and leave around round 8 to fill one daily cap.
Expect two to three weeks of capped standing; nobody calls the grind itself painful.
Players treat the Synoid Heliocor as a niche mastery pick rather than a damage upgrade.
